reviews.title: No way to report a business
reviews.text:
I arrived on time for my scheduled appointment, but the barber kept me waiting for about 25 minutes. I had another commitment and could not wait any longer, so I had to leave. Later, I noticed that the business marked me as a “No-Show,” even though I was physically there on time.

What is very disappointing is that the app does not seem to provide customers with an easy way to dispute a false No-Show, report the business, or provide proof that they actually arrived for their appointment.

Businesses should not be able to damage a customer’s booking history when they are the ones running late. The app needs a proper customer dispute/reporting system and a way to confirm arrival or check in. Until then, the system feels very one-sided and unfair to customers.

⭐ 1/5

reviews.title: About customer support
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience with Booksy

I booked and prepaid for two massage treatments through Booksy. The appointments were cancelled by the therapist due to an injury. Three months later, I still have not received my refund, and the therapist no longer responds to any attempts to contact her.

I contacted Booksy for help, but was simply told that the money had been transferred to the salon and that Booksy was not a party to the matter and could not make the salon refund me.

I understand that Booksy may not be legally responsible for the salon's actions. However, if Booksy facilitates prepayments, I would expect at least some meaningful assistance when a service is cancelled and the salon becomes unresponsive.

My experience has seriously reduced my trust in using Booksy for prepaid bookings. I would advise other users to think twice before paying in advance.

reviews.title: Buen servicio salvo política de devolución
reviews.text:
Quería reservar un corte de pelo utilizando la función de ubicación de la aplicación. Accedí a través de la app, pero por algún motivo la reserva se realizó en una peluquería distinta de la que pretendía seleccionar.

La reserva era para la próxima hora y, prácticamente en el mismo momento de realizarla, comprobé que me había equivocado de establecimiento y procedí inmediatamente a cancelarla. Sin embargo, la aplicación no permite recuperar el importe, aun cuando la reserva fue cancelada prácticamente de forma inmediata y, además, el comercio todavía no había aceptado la reserva.

Considero que se trata claramente de un error humano cometido durante el proceso de reserva, sin que haya existido realmente prestación alguna del servicio ni perjuicio para el establecimiento, ya que la cancelación se realizó antes de que el comercio hubiera aceptado la reserva.

Entiendo que puedan existir políticas de cancelación, pero considero desproporcionado no permitir ningún reembolso en un caso como este, especialmente cuando la cancelación se produce inmediatamente y antes de la aceptación por parte del establecimiento.

Solicito que revisen el caso y procedan al reembolso del importe cobrado.

reviews.title: False Designation
reviews.text: I used Booksy for the first time to book my partner an appointment for a haircut. We booked same day and arrived 5 minutes early for the appointment time. After waiting 10 minutes, I called the number listed for the service provider and they answered the second time. They said they did not have our appointment on their schedule and offered their next appointment if we could wait. We waited until the next appointment and the provider never showed up. The provider marked us as a no-show when in fact they were the one that didn’t show for the rescheduled appointment time. They were unresponsive via text as well. In summary, we waited over an hour for a haircut that never happened. I tried emailing Booksy to get this resolved since we didn’t no-show and I never received a response or status change.

reviews.title: 1-Star Review for Booksy
reviews.text:
Used to love this app. It was simple, convenient, and actually made booking appointments easy without jumping through hoops. Now? It’s turned into a frustrating cash-grab that ruins the whole experience.
They’ve started forcing you to add a credit card just to book anything, supposedly for “cancellation fees.” But it doesn’t stop there — you can’t even complete a booking unless there’s actual money available on the card. What kind of nonsense is this? Not everyone wants to preload funds or risk automatic charges for last-minute changes. It feels invasive, unnecessary, and like they’re holding your appointments hostage until you hand over your payment info.
I get that businesses need to protect against no-shows, but this is overkill. It used to be a good app for quick, hassle-free bookings. Now it’s disappointing, pushy, and makes me want to go back to calling places directly or using literally anything else.
Fix this greedy policy or watch your users leave. Strongly do not recommend anymore.

reviews.title: You can’t write a review unless a barber provides service.
reviews.text: I made an appointment for today Friday April 17, 2026 at 8:30pm. At “Fade ‘Em All” on 84th and Federal. First thing that happened when I got there I arrived to mid argument between barbers (Jandro) and the front assistant. I was sitting down waiting until 8:50pm for someone to greet me.  Jandro finally comes out and said “Hey bro just because it’s after closing hours I am going to charge  you 30 dollars extra.” I asked “Well how much is your hair cut regular price?” He said “65” when in Booky it’s promoting for 60$ ? Why are you already up charging me twice ? He also said it’s in the “policy.” No where in the policy in Booksy does it say that. Keep in mind it’s my first time there. I was flabbergasted to get charged 95 dollars for a low fade. I didn’t know what to respond so I stayed sitting down feeling forced to get the service. I waited for an opportunity to get out but some barbers suggested each other to get “shots” and “let’s get liquor” so they were coming in and out I could leave. I don't want to give my money to someone providing a service intoxicated and he didn’t provide any service but discomfort.

reviews.title: Unprofessional and will avoid you if there’s an issue
reviews.text: Don’t use this place unless you’re confident the treatment you’re having won’t go wrong. You will come up against complete resistance to put it right (no sorry, let’s sort it out) I booked in to have my botch job reviewed, it was confirmed in the app, but arrived for my appointment to be told “Taylor’s not here”. Was advised she’d text me to rearrange but the text never came. Despite having had several messages about the issues, was told they wouldn’t do anything because I’d never contacted them to say there was a problem. Finally offered a good will gesture refund on the proviso I could provide the receipt that I was never given. Had to have their mess sorted elsewhere and was told it was an “injection by numbers” job with no real knowledge or understanding of what they were doing. Filler was placed too close to the surface and not in the right places. The red flag should’ve been when a trainee was doing half my face and I wasn’t asked if that was ok. Absolute joke of a place.

reviews.title: Customers Beware They're Running The Service Providers Away... By A Reliable Service Provider
reviews.text: I've been with booksy for 4years. I had to cancel my account because of clients booking and not showing. I had no show policy in place and even switched to deposit. Despite all of these precautions I still wasted time and money. Eventually leading to booksy blocking my boost and receiving fewer and fewer new clients. I started a new account and the booking issues continued on this account. Leading me to being charged for a no show I didn't know I had. No notifications from booksy on the booksy app about the client or the charge. I noticed because I an extra charge had occurred in my bank account from booksy. I searched everywhere but saw no reason for the charge until I check my client list as I was about to import my clients to another platform. And that's when I saw it; a client I had never seen. They never booked, so I thought. After examining their profile I see their appointment was only a few days prior. Deposit in place; failed charge; no notification and it had not been on my books that day. Side note: I check everyday all day religiously; I had problems with not receiving push notifications from booksy. I reached out to customer service and they offered no resolution only preventative measures; which I had already done. On another point they raised the cap level for 1st time boost services; it was set at 30% up to $50 now if I'm not mistaken it's up to $100 or more. Luckily for me this was my back up booking app. Styleseat is better and they only take up to $50.

reviews.title: Burcu
reviews.text:
I visited your salon using the Vonture Spa & Massage package I purchased from Carrefour. First of all, I would like to point out that although the Vonture brochure clearly states that the hot Thai massage with coconut oil is included in the package, I was asked to pay an additional 20 PLN at your salon.

I understand that the basic principle of the Vonture/Boncure system is that all services listed in the brochure should be included in the purchased package price and no extra charges should be requested for these services. Therefore, I was surprised to be asked for an additional fee. When I asked for an explanation, I was told that “the prices were old and there has been a price increase.” However, I would like to share that I find this inconsistent with the package content from a customer’s perspective and unclear. Since I was running late at the time, I accepted the payment.

Additionally, I was uncomfortable with my back being cracked during the massage without my prior knowledge or consent. After this movement, I felt pain in an area where I had never experienced any issues before; this was unexpected and upsetting for me.

Considering that a massage is generally intended to provide relaxation and a positive experience, unfortunately, this visit had the opposite effect for me. Therefore, I do not feel comfortable returning to your salon at this time.

The filters make no sense — they are completely unrelated to the selected category. There should be filters that are actually useful, such as where you can pay by card. reviews.title: Unreliable Booking System - Repeated Failures
reviews.text:
I’ve experienced multiple issues with Booksy. I booked appointments that were shown as successfully confirmed, yet the bookings never reached the salon. As a result, the staff had no information about my visit when I arrived.

There were also cases where several clients appeared at the same time for the same service, causing scheduling conflicts and leaving businesses to resolve the situation manually.

Due to these recurring problems, I avoid salons that rely on Booksy for their booking system.
Business owners should be aware that customers may choose competitors specifically because of unreliable online scheduling services.
